Research groups stored data on personal drives and departmental servers with inconsistent backups and access control. Central IT could not support growing compute and collaboration needs, and reporting for grants was manual.

A cloud research data hub with project workspaces, lifecycle policies, a catalog for discoverability, and templated analytics environments. CI/CD and infrastructure as code keep environments reproducible across faculties.

We established a landing zone with project-scoped access, migrated priority cohorts with researchers involved in validation, and delivered a portal for dataset discovery, access requests, and standard analytics notebooks.
